rect.desc: Agent frame containing state embedder at top, action embedder below, contextual action embeddings, Q-value panel, policy symbol, and arrows moving from state/action embeddings toward action selection.
Environment frame containing critic/reward function box, question and answer document boxes, and next-state construction with q, c3, and c4, connected by magenta and blue arrows.

g.desc: Current state is composed of query q and selected context c4; this is the origin feeding the agent.
Six context cards arranged horizontally as the long-context document. c4 is gray/selected and rejected by an x above; c3 is the chosen document corresponding to the output action.
The policy chooses action a_t equal to c3, displayed as a yellow document card to the right of the agent.
The critic compares the question and answer; the question box is above the answer box and both point to the next state relation through color-coded arrows.
Next state consists of q, chosen c3, and previous c4, shown in a light-blue panel and receiving the environment/action feedback arrow.
